name: a-crashed-chrome-renderer-leaves-the-palette-see-through
description: A chrome renderer crash reloads every chrome surface in a new view. The palette card's rounded corners must still show the sidebar under them after the reload, not an opaque white rectangle. The browser test cannot read this: on Mac the view reports transparent as white.

assertions.label: the-chrome-renderer-reloaded
assertions.desc: gate: the crash happened after the first open, and the observer reloaded

assertions.label: the-palette-opened-after-the-reload
assertions.desc: gate: the second capture shows a palette

assertions.label: the-card-corner-shows-the-sidebar
assertions.desc: baseline: outside the card's rounded bottom-left corner the grey sidebar reads about 124

assertions.label: the-card-corner-still-shows-the-sidebar-after-the-crash
assertions.desc: an opaque view after the reload fills the corner white, about 250
